title: Runtime weekly agenda — quick handoff (Marisol)
content:
Meeting objective: quick, practical sync focused on remaining rollout tasks for continuous-batching v2, console routing bug, and who takes ownership of next-week on-call rotation.

When: Wed 2026-03-11, 10:00–10:30am PT (timeboxed) — shorthand notes + actions below (left as my scratchpad for handoff to Rowan if I need to duck out).

Attendees (expected):
- Marisol (owner) — prep + ops handoff
- Omar — kernel selection / perf numbers
- Lena — console + rollouts dashboard
- Kai — infra autoscaler tweaks
- Rowan — SRE liaison / on-call schedule
- Priya — CI / e2e test owner

Agenda / flow (8–10 min per block):
1) Quick status check (5 min) — major blockers only
   - Marisol: deploy plan for continuous-batching v2 prepared, but need canary + rollback playbook validated.
   - Omar: perf regression on 2-request step load (observed +4% p99 on longer sequences).
   - Lena: console route filter bug still intermittently hiding dedicated pools.

2) Continuous-batching v2 rollout (10 min)
   - Goal: enable v2 on dedicated pool alpha for two customers next Thursday (2026-03-19).
   - Checklist (what remains):
     * Canary config file (env flags) — DONE (Marisol)
     * Canary monitoring threshold alerts — TODO (Lena)
     * Automated rollback: smoke test failing => immediate rollback via job — TODO (Priya to script)
     * Customer communication note — TODO (Marisol to draft)
   - Risks: KV cache invalidation on mixed-quant models (low prob) — Omar to add short test to perf suite.

3) Console routing bug + observability gap (7 min)
   - Issue: routes with regional affinity sometimes show zero capacity in Console UI though runtime reports capacity=ok.
   - Hypothesis: stale cache at summary layer when pool label updates race with capacity refresh.
   - Immediate mitigation: add extra fetch on 10s interval for affected routes; longer-term: ensure event-driven refresh.
   - Action: Lena to push hotfix (feature flag) by EOD Wed and coordinate with Kai for safe rollout.

4) On-call / handoff notes (5 min)
   - Next-week on-call: Rowan (primary) / Omar (secondary). Confirmed? ROWAN YES, OMAR tentative — Omar needs to finish kernel regression fix.
   - Escalation path reminder: paging -> on-call -> infra lead -> SRE manager. Put link in Slack #oncall.

5) Quick parking lot + blockers (3 min)
   - CI flaky test: model-endpoint-e2e::kv-cache-timeout failing ~1 out of 12 runs. Priya to triage next two runs and open RW ticket if it persists.
   - Billing tag for canary traffic: need to ensure test traffic is excluded from customer billing metrics (product asks). Marisol to reach out to finance; tag = canary-test-2026-03.

Decisions made during sync:
- Ship continuous-batching v2 to dedicated alpha 2026-03-19 with canary and rollback (if smoke fails). Owner: Marisol.
- Console UI hotfix feature-flagged rollout by Lena + infra coordination with Kai.
- On-call primary next week: Rowan. Secondary: Omar (conditional).

Action items (tracked quick list) — include owner, due date, smoke status: open/blocked/done
- Draft customer communication for alpha canary (owner: Marisol) — due: 2026-03-16 — status: open
- Implement smoke test rollback job for canary (owner: Priya) — due: 2026-03-17 — status: in_progress (has starter script)
- Add perf regression test for multi-request sequences (owner: Omar) — due: 2026-03-15 — status: open
- Push console route summary hotfix behind flag (owner: Lena) — due: 2026-03-11 EOD — status: in_progress (PR opened)
- Coordinate feature-flag rollout window with autoscaler team (owner: Kai) — due: 2026-03-12 — status: open
- Run CI e2e twice and mark flaky tests (owner: Priya) — due: 2026-03-13 — status: in_progress
- Exclude canary traffic from billing metrics; reach out to finance (owner: Marisol) — due: 2026-03-16 — status: open

Notes to self / handoff pointers for Rowan: (if I need to duck out)
- If I disappear during the week: follow action-item list in priority order; canary shipping is highest priority.
- If perf regression appears during canary: trigger rollback job (Priya's script) and call Omar.
- Console hotfix: toggled via FF_CONSOLE_ROUTE_FIX; if flag causes UI issues, revert via feature flag console.
- Slack snippets: use template in Confluence page "Weeklies and Runbooks" — first paragraph of customer note should say "alpha, non-billable".

Open questions / follow-ups (for next sync)
- Do we need a metric that directly ties KV cache eviction rate to p99 latency? (Omar to prototype a dashboard tile)
- Is the billing-team comfortable with a short-lived canary-exclusion tag? (Marisol to confirm)
- Longer term: consider a canary orchestration job that integrates with rollouts and billing tags (product ask).

Quick references & links (copy for ticket creation):
- Perf regression PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1425
- Runbook / weeklies: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUNTIME/Weeklies+and+Runbooks
- Jira: RW-8421 (canary rollout checklist), RW-8672 (console routing bug)

Misc scratch thoughts (not for meeting):
- Might be worth trying a smaller canary % but longer duration (e.g., 2% for 48h) vs 10% for 2h — catch slow-rising regressions.
- If QA has capacity, ask them to run a focused long-seq stress test against canary pool overnight.

End of notes — will tidy and convert into a PRD-ish customer note after action items get moving.

Marisol
